title: Nebula Form Definition
description: Declarative schema for a Nebula admin form (non-EAV). Files live at view/adminhtml/form/<id>.json. EAV forms (`type: eav`) use form-eav.schema.json instead. A file MAY be a `base` (contains `id`) or an `overlay` fragment merged onto the base.

id.title: Form identifier
id.description: Unique snake_case identifier. Base files MUST set this and it MUST match the file name (without .json). Overlay files MUST omit it.

acl.title: ACL resource
acl.description: Magento ACL resource required to access the form.

fieldsets.title: Fieldsets
fieldsets.description: Map of fieldset_id -> fieldset definition. Use for classic column-based forms. Mutually exclusive with `layout`.

layout.title: Layout tree
layout.description: Tree of layout nodes (row/column/section/tabs). Use for complex multi-row layouts. Mutually exclusive with `fieldsets`.

hiddenFields.title: Hidden fields
hiddenFields.description: Map of name -> static value rendered as <input type="hidden"> alongside the form.

route.title: Admin route
route.description: Admin action name(s) this form mounts on. May be one route or several (e.g. both the edit and new actions).

replaces.title: Legacy block name(s)
replaces.description: Legacy layout block name(s) this form supersedes and removes. May be one block, or several (e.g. a tabs block plus its JS block). Block names vary in convention — dots, dashes and underscores all occur (e.g. adminhtml.user.edit.tabs, tax-rate-form).

oneOf.title: Overlay fragment
oneOf.description: An overlay from another module. Must NOT set `id`.

dataSource.title: Form data source
dataSource.description: A data provider alias plus provider-specific config (typically an identifier request param).

provider.title: Form provider alias
provider.description: Alias registered in DataProviderRegistry (e.g. catalog.product.form). FQCNs are rejected — register an alias in etc/di.xml.

config.title: Provider config
config.description: Free-form map forwarded to the provider. Well-known: identifierParam.

identifierParam.title: Identifier request param
identifierParam.description: Request param carrying the entity id, e.g. `id`.

title.title: Page title
title.description: Displayed in the admin header above the form.

saveUrl.title: Save URL
saveUrl.description: Admin route the form POSTs to.

backUrl.title: Back URL
backUrl.description: Admin route the Back button navigates to.

deleteUrl.title: Delete URL
deleteUrl.description: Admin route the Delete button navigates to.

identifierField.title: Identifier field
identifierField.description: Name of the DB-level identifier (e.g. entity_id, rule_id) used for load/save.

identifierParam.title: Identifier request param
identifierParam.description: DEPRECATED. The identifier param is now derived automatically from dataSource.config.identifierParam and must not be set manually in settings. This property is retained in the schema for backward compatibility with forms outside this repository.

fieldPrefix.title: Field name prefix
fieldPrefix.description: Submit-time namespace for field names. Used by entities whose controllers expect `product[name]` instead of `name`.

hiddenParams.title: Hidden request params
hiddenParams.description: Request params that are captured on page open and re-submitted as hidden inputs.

layout.title: Columnar layout hint
layout.description: Used by non-`layout`-tree forms to hint at a two- or three-column fieldset arrangement.

template.title: Template override
template.description: Override the phtml that renders the form shell, e.g. `Qoliber_NebulaCatalog::eav/form-with-sidebar.phtml`.

sidebarRenderer.title: Sidebar renderer
sidebarRenderer.description: Snippet id rendered in the sidebar when the template supports one.

label.title: Fieldset label
label.description: Header text shown above the fieldset. Empty string allowed for snippet-rendered fieldsets.

open.title: Initially open
open.description: Whether the collapsible fieldset starts expanded.

column.title: Column slot
column.description: For columnar layouts: which column to render this fieldset into.

columns.title: Internal column count
columns.description: How many columns the fields inside this fieldset flow into.

renderer.title: Snippet renderer
renderer.description: Render the entire fieldset body via a snippet. Used when `fields` is absent or empty.

rule_type.title: Rule editor type
rule_type.description: For rule-condition fieldsets rendered by snippet.rule_conditions: which rule engine to bind to. `sales_actions` renders the sales-rule "Apply To" tree (Product\Combine root, binds to actions_serialized, POSTs as rule[actions][...]).

label.title: Field label
label.description: Label shown next to the input.

type.title: Field type
type.description: Built-in input type. Mutually exclusive with `renderer`.

renderer.title: Snippet renderer
renderer.description: Render the field body via a snippet. Mutually exclusive with `type`.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether the value must be non-empty.

note.title: Helper note
note.description: Muted text rendered below the input.

default.title: Default value
default.description: Initial value when the field is not populated from the data source.

disableOnEdit.title: Disable on edit
disableOnEdit.description: If true, the field is read-only when editing an existing entity.

colspan.title: Column span
colspan.description: How many columns this field spans in a multi-column fieldset.

optionsSource.title: Options source alias
optionsSource.description: For select/multiselect: alias registered in OptionSourceRegistry (e.g. magento.store.system). FQCNs are rejected — register an alias in etc/di.xml.

optionsMethod.title: Options source method
optionsMethod.description: Method to invoke on the options source (defaults to toOptionArray).

options.title: Inline options
options.description: Inline option list for select/multiselect as [{value, label}, ...].

submitName.title: Submit name override
submitName.description: POST key used when the wire format differs from the JSON field key (e.g. frontend_label[0]). Field key must match [a-z][a-z0-9_]* — use this for bracket-notation overrides.

$remove.title: Remove flag
$remove.description: Overlay-only: removes this field from the merged definition.

id.title: Node id
id.description: Stable id used for overlay merging. Required on base rows, optional on leaf nodes.

type.title: Node type
type.description: Node kind. Optional on overlay fragments that identify a base node by `id` only.

fields.title: Fields list
fields.description: For type=section or type=fields: list of field names to render in order.

groups.title: Attribute groups
groups.description: For EAV sections/tabs: list of attribute group codes to pull fields from.

renderer.title: Snippet renderer
renderer.description: Render this node body via a snippet.

condition.title: Conditional rendering
condition.description: Map of field -> expected value(s). The node is only rendered when the entity satisfies every condition.
